'''Assimara Endermen''' are the [[:Category:Assimara_Parasites|Assimara Version]] of Endermen. It features 12 tentacles and 2 legs, with 4 of the tentacles being on its mouth. Effectively unrecognizable from its uninfected form, being a greyish brown colour and having 2 extra joints on each limb. 

== ''Spawning'' ==

* Spawns individually, from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 4|Phase 4]] onward, with a spawnweight of 1, once 9 Endermen have been assimilated.

== ''Behavior'' ==
Assimara Endermen are Hit and Run Offensive Grappler Melee Combatants.

* Their Melee Attack is performed through contact damage, which has a 20% chance to inflict [[Bleeding]] for 5 seconds.
* Assimara Endermen will grab their target if in melee range, preventing them from moving, this will do continuous immunity-frame bypassing damage, apply Weakness IV at the start for 2 seconds, Mining Fatigue II, and Slowness II. The target will be pulled to the Assimara Enderman while in this state.
* Assimara Endermen are able to teleport themselves. Their teleportation Ability is based on the following logic:
** Upon sight of a Player, the teleportation noise will play.
** Assimara Endermen cannot teleport within the first 1.5 seconds of finding a target.
* Assimara Endermen can perform great leaps.
* Assimara Endermen are immune to fall damage.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of an Assimara Enderman will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
* Assimara Endermen are immune to ranged attacks, teleporting away from Projectiles, similar to their Sane counterpart.
* Assimara Endermen are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.
* Assimara Endermen are able to dive in liquids to pursue submerged targets.
* On death, Assimara Endermen have a chance to explode, releasing [[Remains|Assimara Remains]] and an effect cloud of stacking Poison and [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]].

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
* Assimara Endermen, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Upon sight of a Player, the teleportation noise will play.
* Assimara Endermen cannot teleport within the first 1.5 seconds of finding a target.
